read_ipc_read_arrow_file: read an Arrow IPC (Feather v2) file into a Polars DataFrame with optional column selection and row limiting
read_ipc_stream_read_arrow_stream: read an Arrow IPC record batch stream into a Polars DataFrame with optional column selection and row limiting
read_ipc_schema_get_ipc_file_schema: get the schema of an Arrow IPC file without reading any data, returning column names and data types
scan_ipc_lazy_read_arrow_files: lazily scan one or multiple Arrow IPC files via glob patterns for optimized query execution
